 TNN / Nov 14, 2026, 23:08 IST Save Comments Share Aa + Text Size Small
 Medium
 Large
 Print New Delhi: Delhi is likely to receive very light rain or drizzle under the influence of a western disturbance Sunday. After the western disturbance passes, the city may record a drop in the night temperatures. The minimum temperature is likely to reach 12 degrees Celsius by Nov 18. “There is a possibility of a spell of very light rain or drizzle towards Sunday morning to forenoon at isolated places,” said a Met official. The minimum temperature was 16.4 degrees Celsius, three degrees above normal, Saturday. It is likely to stay between 16 and 18 degrees Celsius Sunday. As the western disturbance is expected to cause heavy snowfall in Jammu & Kashmir, cold north-westerly winds from snow-capped mountains are likely to lead to a drop in the minimum temperature next week.  The minimum temperature may remain between 14 and 16 degrees Celsius Monday and drop to 12 degrees Celsius by Wednesday. The season’s lowest minimum temperature was 14.8 degrees Celsius on Nov 11. The maximum temperature Saturday settled at 30.4 degrees Celsius, two notches above normal. “A fall in maximum temperatures by 3-4 degrees Celsius is likely during the next 24 hours and no significant change thereafter,” said the official. It is likely to stay around 25 degrees Celsius Sunday.
